source.text:
Location: Brisbane, Australia (UTC+10, no daylight saving)

Remote: Yes. US West Coast afternoons are my mornings, and I fully overlap with AU/NZ

Willing to relocate: No

Technologies: TypeScript, React, Vue, Next.js, SwiftUI, Figma, design tokens

Résumé/CV: https://gardiner.today

LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/jordsta

Email: hn@jobs.gardiner.today

Design engineer with 18+ years of experience. I make the part of the product people touch.

- Canva: 2.5 years on the Brand Templates enterprise team. Sole frontend engineer on Brand Style Match (featured at Canva Create), and helped with a multi-year undertaking to remove what their most senior engineer called Canva's biggest ever piece of tech debt.

- Hai! Coffee: my SwiftUI pour-over timer that learns from each brew, designed for someone half awake at the kettle.

- ha-desky: an open-source Home Assistant integration that drives my Desky standing desk over the Bluetooth already in its controller, so that I can do cool automations like sitting/standing on a schedule. My first Python repo, now in the HACS default store.

The quickest way to get to know me is to ask my site:

claude mcp add --transport http gardiner https://gardiner.today/mcp

Or paste your job ad into Ardo, my AI agent at https://gardiner.today and it'll tell you how I match.

I hold a firm line on accessibility, and I don't ship code I can't explain.

Looking for: design engineer or senior frontend, full-time, on a team that cares about craft.
